Tasteless food, 0 service
Sep 2026 • Couples
Unfortunately, it was a huge disappointment for us. We give one star and will definitely not come back here.

It all started with rolls. I specifically ordered a small portion - 4 pieces. But they brought them to me without soy sauce, ginger, and wasabi. I had to ask for all of this separately. Moreover, they didn't even bring napkins initially—we had to ask for those too. It seems like elementary things for a restaurant, but for some reason, you have to ask for them separately here. And then it became clear that both the kitchen and the service were lacking.

My man was served fish—it was fried in so much oil that the oil itself overpowered the taste of the fish. They served some green sauce on the side in a small dish, but it didn't match the dish at all and only overpowered the flavor even more. In the end, everything together turned out very unharmonious and strange.

The pork was also absolutely unimpressive. Not a single dish all evening caused even a "wow" effect. And they served french fries with the pork. And here we didn't understand the concept at all. French fries are still the most ordinary and simple food, which you are more likely to expect in a cafe or fast food place, but not as a side dish in an expensive restaurant with corresponding prices.

In the end, they paid a very handsome amount—it felt like a good dinner in an expensive restaurant in Sochi—but didn't get any pleasure at all. Neither from the food nor from the service.

It's a pity about the money and the evening spent. We really didn't like it here, so we definitely won't come back.

—

Honestly, for us this is a very disappointing experience. We can only give it one star and definitely will not return.

It all started with the sushi roll. I intentionally ordered the small portion with only 4 pieces, but when it arrived, there was no soy sauce, pickled ginger, or wasabi. We have to ask the new employee who was brought in. Even at first, there were no tissues on the table, and we had to ask for them ourselves. These are all very basic things for a restaurant, but here customers have to ask about everything. Then we realized that both the food and the service had problems.

My boyfriend ordered fish. The fish was fried too thoroughly and with too much oil, to the point where the oil flavor almost completely overpowered the fish's flavor. The dish is also served with a green sauce kept separately in a small bowl, but this sauce is completely unharmonious with the fish and even detracts from the natural flavor of the dish. Overall, this dish is really unbalanced and quite confusing.

The pork dish was also completely unimpressive. Throughout the meal, no dish made us feel "wow." What is even more confusing is that pork is served with french fries. In our opinion, french fries are a very simple dish, usually suitable for casual eateries or fast food rather than a side dish in a high-end restaurant like this.

In the end, we paid a considerable amount—it felt like having dinner at an expensive restaurant in Sochi—but we absolutely did not get a commensurate experience in return. Both the food and the service did not satisfy us.

I'm sorry for wasting your money and time on this dinner. We really didn't like the experience here and definitely won't come back a second time.

Below average BBQ Place
Apr 2023 • Couples
Visited the restaurant looking for non-Vietnamese food for a change. Was greatly impressed with the set up.. looks very authentic Japanese BBQ place.. ordered a combo set with an assortment of meats. When the meat arrived, found that they were all marinated meats, unlike the photo on the menu. The meats are of mediocre cuts and tasted tough & rubbery even medium rare.. the marinate was over-powering and don’t suit our taste buds. We ordered some pork and same marinate. Even the mushroom are marinated. Killed all the tastebuds with the marinate.. perhaps our expectations were too high to expect quality beef in Danang.. Greatly disappointed!
